reason: A voice-input plugin that records speech in the browser and inserts transcribed text into the DSH conversation composer using browser recognition or configurable OpenAI-compatible transcription APIs.

summaries.zh: 在 DSH 对话输入框中通过浏览器语音识别或可配置的 OpenAI 兼容转写接口将语音转换为文字。
summaries.en: Adds voice input to the DSH conversation composer by converting speech to text with browser recognition or configurable OpenAI-compatible transcription APIs.

capabilities: Captures microphone audio through browser APIs
Transcribes audio using browser speech recognition or OpenAI-compatible external APIs
Sends recorded audio to a configured transcription endpoint
Stores non-secret configuration in browser localStorage
Keeps the API key in page memory according to the README
